name: The nuclear atom and fundamental particles

terms.definition: A particle that experiences the strong nuclear force; it is made of quarks.
A fundamental particle that does not experience the strong nuclear force, such as the electron and the neutrino.
A hadron made of three quarks, such as the proton (uud) and the neutron (udd).
A hadron made of a quark and an antiquark.
A particle with the same mass as its particle but the opposite charge.
terms.examiner: The positron is the antiparticle of the electron.

terms.definition: Nuclei of the same element with the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
